package.scope: Six original fully worked cases, twelve complete paired solutions, answered teach-back and delayed retention; no canonical acceptance or publication claim.

proof_audit.judgment: Finite strict one-to-one DA terminates, remains individually rational and is stable. The earliest achievable rejection argument covers outside options and proves proposer optimality and order independence. The text explicitly does not infer incentive compatibility from comparison within a fixed stable set.

A finite alternating path proves unmatched-set invariance; its no-cycle step propagates a first repetition backward using injectivity. Reject-all IPDA and the removed-applicant market define one report-independent menu. Singleton stability plus unmatched invariance puts each actual APDA partner in the menu. The reproduced APDA prefix, truncated IPDA and permanent receiver-holding rule exclude every reported-better menu element. Every ordered-subset report, including false acceptability and the empty report, therefore selects its reported best menu member; truth maximizes over the fixed menu including outside.

Summing nonnegative buyer-utility and seller-price edge bounds covers every feasible partial assignment. Tight assigned edges and zero unused terms certify attainment and individual demand without assuming general price existence or LP integrality. Baseline and forbidden-edge certificates, complete maximizer sets, recipient ownership and actual cash conservation are independently verified.

Strict own concavity gives the clipped affine best reply; a row-norm bound yields a geometric Cauchy proof on the closed unbounded orthant. Planner welfare differs from the potential by the second endpoint cross term. Positive-definite square completion proves the global optimum. The capped funded variant balances charges at every profile and maintains cash feasibility before subsidy distribution; own-independent charges preserve incentives. Direct equations give the exact complement threshold and the separately changed cap outcome.

Every zero/interior active pattern is exhausted. The singular gamma=1 interior face yields the full segment, with boundary endpoints included. A sum/product decomposition proves the complete global planner sets and equality cases for gamma=1/2,1,2. Pure equilibrium multiplicity and welfare comparisons carry no mixed-equilibrium, stability or selection claim.

Four architectures exhaust all eight labeled graphs. Every deletion/addition incentive proves the pairwise-stability regions with the declared weak/strict consent convention. Direct welfare differences prove the complete efficient regions and boundary ties. Conditional payments are balanced at every graph, while real link costs consume endowed cash. The target is stable but the first-link aggregate deficit persists; a coordinated three-party package changes the allowed deviation, not the arithmetic.

exercise_audit.judgment: Proved termination, stability, earliest achievable rejection and order independence; explained exactly why these do not alone prove truthfulness.

Enumerated all 21 individually rational partial matchings and the two stable outcomes; independently computed all four removed-market menus, plus participant removal and priority reversal. Corrected the removed-A IPDA trace and made the removed-B subject names explicit.

Reproved the finite unmatched-set lemma, reject-all/removed-market identity, singleton membership, truncation prefix and fixed-menu incentive conclusion, including truly unacceptable reports and outside.

Forced D–W, exhausted all six remaining permutations with four explicit blocking witnesses, and checked the recipient lie plus one-name/two-name reporting constraints. Kept changes of participant set, priorities and report domain separate.
Derived the partial-assignment bound and equality conditions. Checked all 34 assignments, six full values, baseline certificate, unique optimum 26, and the 60-unit owned cash account.

Checked all 27 allowed assignments and both value-25 optima. The only negative certificate slack lies on the removed B–Z edge. Positive unused utility rules out an attaining partial assignment; zero prices fail market clearing.

Derived best replies by square completion and full geometric-Cauchy contraction proof. Recomputed the path equilibrium and 172/49 welfare; used the gamma=1 continuum to refute uniqueness from own curvature alone.

Proved global planner optimality and unique capped funded equilibrium. Verified every-profile funding bounds, the balanced collection/distribution order, target cash (17/2,13,17/2), net increments (0,5,0), and endpoint losses despite aggregate gain.

Derived the exact positive-equilibrium threshold beta<1/sqrt(2), including nonexistence at equality. Verified beta=3/5 beyond the sufficient row bound, rejected the negative formal inverse at beta=3/4, and proved the unique changed cap-2 equilibrium.

Exhausted the active patterns and full gamma=1 continuum; derived all requested welfare values and complete global planner sets using S and the product. No numerical inverse is used to discard singular or boundary equilibria.

Proved the full eight-graph stability/efficiency classification and all tie conventions; independently checked thresholds 6/25,3/5,39/50 and both cost interventions, distinguishing architecture from labeled uniqueness.

Verified all state-contingent transfers, funded cost/payment order, cash (23/20,9/10,23/20), keep/add margins and first-link impossibility. The research rubric distinguishes incentives, comparable welfare, selection and causal identification, with explicit credit for a defensible funded alternative.

instruction_audit.sequence: Strict matching, feasible deviations and outside options precede the complete incentive proof; monetary assignment then introduces owners and transfers; network games distinguish equilibrium, welfare and funded implementation before endogenous link formation.
instruction_audit.structure: Six literal worked articles; twelve unique exercise IDs paired inside details.solutions; chapter-prefixed IDs, four flat chapter routes, five exact source IDs/URLs, and answered teaching/retention disclosures. Successor is V13-C12.
instruction_audit.reader_reproduction: The text supplies finite enumeration and algebra instructions, describing the production checker as editorial verification rather than an unavailable reader download.
instruction_audit.self_review: Full manuscript and all exact prompts/solutions were read during authoring; final code and both records were read before the final gates. Universal proof reasoning is separately audited above; finite arithmetic is not represented as its proof.

numerical_audit.independence: A new simultaneous-round DA oracle differs from the preparation queue algorithm. Stable outcomes are reconstructed from all feasible individual-rational matchings after every unilateral report. Assignment values are enumerated directly; LQ active faces use rational elimination with singular-face reporting; graph benefits use direct and two-hop paths.
numerical_audit.coverage: 324 complete unilateral ordered-subset reports and 324 exhaustive stable-profile reconstructions; both full stable sets and all menus; recipient/list-cap/participation transfers; 34 and 27 partial assignments; global welfare coefficient identity; funded cash and incidence; complement feedback and cap changes; substitute singular continuum; all eight graphs at seven purposeful cost boundaries and every funded contract state.
numerical_audit.printed_results: All 28 data-calc anchors are independently compared to exact arithmetic. Non-anchor exact statements are checked by the proof/exercise audits and finite interventions, including the corrected W1 traces and solution 12 cash ledger.

domain_audit.supported: Matching and assignment sides have at most four names/units; game vectors at most three agents; graph exactly the three-node universe. Numeric helpers accept exact int/float/Fraction types, excluding bool; finite magnitude at most 10^6 and reduced denominator at most 10^12. This is a denominator limit, not a decimal-place limit.
domain_audit.coverage: Malformed/duplicate/unknown reports; nonindividual-rational or duplicate seats; matrix/eligibility/certificate errors; self interaction and action-cap violations; malformed edges and benefit/cost/transfer restrictions; Boolean numerics, nonfinite values, bounded numeric overflow; duplicate or nonfinite JSON including exponent overflow.
domain_audit.valid_failure: Valid inputs can return an infeasible financial design, a failed certificate, an empty equilibrium set or a singular face. Such economic failures are not mislabeled as malformed inputs.
domain_audit.exceptions: Explicit ValueError/TypeError checks are exercised under ordinary and optimized Python; no assert statement carries validation.

resolved_findings.finding: The original removed-A IPDA explanation reversed B’s ranking and incorrectly left X held. Corrected to B holding Y and rejecting X, leaving X empty, Y–B and Z–C. The menu {outside,X,Y} and all theorem conclusions were unchanged. Added an exact smaller-market regression.
Clarified the separate subjects: X ranks B above A, and Y ranks B above outside. No number, model or conclusion changed.

Removed redundant independent_case_evidence from source-only preparation and refreshed the blueprint’s source-preparation binding. At execution the redundant field had already been refreshed, so no claim is made that the deleted bytes still contained stale hashes. Current computation provenance remains solely in the blueprint; all twenty primary-artifact bindings are unchanged.

limits: The matching theorem is individual proposer strategy-proofness for finite strict one-to-one ordered-subset reports with outside options; no ties, capacities, couples or group incentive theorem is claimed.
Assignment proofs verify supplied certificates; general equilibrium-price existence, Hall’s theorem and assignment-polytope integrality are not imported.

Network results concern the specified pure-action games, exact action domains and three-node formation rules. No general spectral classification, mixed-strategy completeness, adjustment dynamics or causal-identification theorem is claimed.

Funded policies stipulate enforceability, endowed cash and payment order. Aggregate gains need not be voluntary Pareto improvements; transfers do not erase real resource costs or authorize missing coordination rights.

Primary inspection is scoped to the actual bodies/pages/images recorded in the source preparation. No whole-document verification, invented current institution rule or empirical observation is claimed.
